mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays elevated relative to the prior month, commuting-linked discretionary trips rise with a lag and lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The effect is strongest when TRANSIT does not keep falling, because access friction otherwise blocks the retail rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is less negative than t-3w while RETAIL_REC remains below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-28-day mean even as WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT is flat or improving.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PARKS mobility signals substitution toward indoor and local errands, and that shift pulls RETAIL_REC down within one to two weeks. This mechanism fails if the parks drop is temporary and immediately reverses without any matching fall in GROCERY_PHARM or TRANSIT.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 20 percent above baseline after being above 30 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 43.0 at t-3w to 11.3 at t-1w while RETAIL_REC stayed negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days after PARKS drops below the stated threshold and no concurrent transit or workplace deterioration appears.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains deeply negative and WORKPLACES also stays suppressed, the combined signal indicates constrained urban circulation and fewer impulse shopping trips, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks. The mechanism requires both mobility channels to stay weak; either one recovering weakens the forecasted retail drag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -15 and WORKPLACES stays below -10 for at least two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both negative in all observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below the prior 28-day mean when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES satisfy the low-mobility condition for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: An upswing in RESIDENTIAL time without a matching rise in external activity indicates more time spent at home, which suppresses shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next week. This signal fails if residential stay-at-home intensity is offset by stronger workplace or transit recovery.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is positive in every observed week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 7 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above its recent average and no improvement in TRANSIT or WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM is an early sign of more local errand traffic and neighborhood movement, which spills into retail visits over the next two to four weeks. The effect is strongest when PARKS also recover, because it confirms broader willingness to leave home.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 9 after being below 8 in the previous week

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not higher than its last-28-day average after GROCERY_PHARM crosses the trigger and PARKS does not weaken.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in TRANSIT improves access to retail corridors and supports higher RETAIL_REC with about a two-week lag. If transit remains negative, retail cannot fully rebound even when other categories stabilize.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved only modestly from -19.9 to -18.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after the two-week TRANSIT recovery pattern appears.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain negative but RESIDENTIAL stays positive, the city is in a partial-restriction pattern that shifts spending toward home-based consumption and away from discretionary retail. Under this regime, RETAIL_REC should drift lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain negative and RESIDENTIAL remains positive.

mechanism_narrative: A reversal in PARKS from extreme strength to moderate strength marks weather or seasonal normalization, and retail spending follows by softening over the next month as outdoor destination trips lose momentum. The signal fails if PARKS stabilizes while RETAIL_REC still falls, because then parks are not the active driver.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 20 points from its recent peak
